_README: Fraud-desk contacts shown to someone who has just lost money. A wrong number here
sends a victim to a fraudster, so NOTHING in this file may be guessed, remembered
or copied from a search result. Every contact needs `source` (the bank's own site)
and `verifiedOn` (the date a human opened that page and read the number).
Entries with verifiedOn = null are treated as absent: escalate.ts falls back to
'use the number on the back of your card or inside your banking app', which is the
safest advice anyway because fake bank helplines are a common second scam.
To fill one in: open the bank's official website, find the fraud / dispute contact,
paste it below with the page URL and today's date. See scripts/check-help.mjs.
_turnaroundNote: CBN's consumer-protection resolution window for a bank complaint, in working days. Set this from the CBN framework itself, not from memory. Until it is set, TRACE tells people to escalate once their bank stops responding rather than quoting a deadline.

cbn.label: CBN Consumer Protection
cbn.role: Escalate here when your bank has not resolved your complaint. They will ask for your bank's complaint reference, so get that first.

police.label: Police Cybercrime Centre
police.role: For the criminal side. Report in parallel with your bank, not instead of it.

efcc.label: EFCC
efcc.role: For financial crime, especially larger amounts or an organised pattern.
